behaviors.behavior: a grill-trace record is written to disk (created) and re-writing the same requirement_key updates it in place, idempotently
a malformed payload is rejected before any I/O happens (no partial write)
the --payload-file CLI contract safely carries interview text containing a single quote (no shell quote-breakout)
the producer's write and the sanctioned reader's read of the same grill-trace round-trip every field (ADR-024 affected-boundaries probe)
requirement_key is validated lower-kebab-case (a-z0-9, single hyphens) and rejected otherwise, foreclosing path-traversal filenames

each of the seven dimensions must be present and answered/assumed:<reason>/n-a:<reason> -- a missing key is rejected at write time (parse_trace), a bad shape/value is caught by the gate's check_blank_dimension

STOP 2 -- any 'assumed' dimension value fires in /shipwright-project's surface, with no exceptions; a non-'project' surface trace under a project's planning tree is a data-integrity FAIL, not an exemption
STOP 3 -- a declared term resolving in neither shared/glossary.md nor the target project's CONTEXT.md (read via P4.1's context_md_format.read_terms) fires; matching is exact-case, exact-prose
STOP 4 -- outcome answered with no fit_criterion fires; outcome not answered does not trigger the rule
honesty guard -- a structurally complete but low-quality (terse, one-word) trace passes the FULL run_all_checks() gate; the gate never judges prose
honesty guard mirror -- the same terse prose style does not mask a genuine STOP (an 'assumed' value is a real declined-to-ask, not a quality defect)
grill_trace_coverage: an interview ran but zero traces were written at all is caught
fr_trace_coverage: a partially recorded interview (some requirements traced, one FR row without a matching trace) is caught even when grill_trace_coverage alone would pass
a malformed grill-trace JSON file on disk is reported as a red CheckResult, never an unhandled crash
a missing shared/glossary.md (broken install) is reported as its own failing check, distinct from a legitimately absent CONTEXT.md
a glossary_delta-recorded term not listed in terms_used is caught as a self-consistency gap
